title: Night Cream in an AC Room: How to Stop Waking Up With Dry Skin
ex: Sleeping in AC dries skin for hours. A simple night routine, how much cream for your skin type, and room fixes from vent angle to a bowl of water.
rt: Night Cream in AC Room: Stop Dry Skin Overnight | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream in AC room: why skin gets dry when you sleep in AC, a simple night routine, how much cream to use, and room fixes like a humidifier or water bowl.
quick: Yes, use night cream when you sleep in AC, often a little more. Apply it to slightly damp skin, add a thin extra layer on the cheeks and around the nose, and point the vent away from your face. A small humidifier, or even a bowl of water nearby, adds some moisture back.
facts: AC pulls moisture out of the room air
Apply cream to slightly damp skin
Angle the vent away from your face
Many people sleep comfortably at 24 to 26°C
